templates.decision.insufficient_data: Not enough recent price data to advise
templates.best_now: Best market today for {crop}: {market}, modal price ₹{modal}/quintal (reported {date}). After transport (about ₹{transport}/quintal) and market fees you would get about ₹{net}/quintal.
templates.hold_case: Prices are rising about {trend}% a day. Holding {h} days could give about ₹{hold_net}/quintal at {hold_market} after storage cost and weight loss, about ₹{gain}/quintal more. Prices can still move by around ₹{sigma}/quintal either way.
templates.reason.holding_costs_exceed_expected_ris: Prices are rising slightly, but storage cost and weight loss over {h} days would eat up the gain.
templates.reason.prices_flat_or_falling: Prices are flat or falling, so holding is unlikely to pay.
templates.reason.expected_gain_too_small_for_risk: Holding might add about ₹{gain}/quintal, but that is small compared with how much prices move (about ₹{sigma}/quintal), so it is not worth the risk.
templates.reason.perishable_crop: {crop} spoils quickly, so holding is risky.
templates.reason.some_markets_stale: Some markets have not reported prices recently and were left out: {stale}.
templates.insufficient: The latest price reports for {crop} are older than {days} days or missing, so I cannot give reliable sell or hold advice. Please check today's rate at the mandi or with your trader before selling.
templates.unsupported_crop: I can currently advise on these crops only: {crops}. Please ask about one of them.
templates.synthetic_note: Note: these prices are demo (synthetic) data, not real market reports.
templates.disclaimer: This is decision support, not a guarantee. Prices can change; confirm with your trader before you sell.
templates.alert.title: {crop} price alert
templates.alert.above: {crop} at {market} is now ₹{price}/quintal (reported {date}), above your ₹{threshold} alert.
templates.alert.below: {crop} at {market} is now ₹{price}/quintal (reported {date}), below your ₹{threshold} alert.
templates.reason.seasonal_rise: Last year, prices rose about {season}% over the same {h} days.
